summary: This directory is dedicated to the automated verification and validation of security-related path processing logic, ensuring that file system access and path resolutions adhere to established safety constraints.
responsibilities: Verify security constraints for file system operations
Test path normalization and resolution security
relationships: Test suites verify that path normalization procedures prevent unauthorized directory traversal.
Validation logic ensures that security constraints are applied consistently before any file system access occurs.
designDecisions: Collocation of test files with source logic to maintain strict verification cycles
Isolation of security-critical path operations from general utilities
